# GrexLabs — Free AI API Platform (no API key needed)

> GrexLabs (https://www.grexlabs.in) is a free, keyless, OpenAI-compatible AI API gateway serving 314+ large language models from 25+ providers, plus a free web search API and a free image generation API. Free `:free` models need NO API key: no signup, no credit card, unlimited requests. Premium flagship models (GPT-6.2 Astra, Claude Fable 5.2, Gemini 4 Carbon, Grok 4.7) require a valid `sk-gl-` key; with no key or a wrong key only free `:free` models work.

## Primary endpoints

- [OpenAI chat completions](https://www.grexlabs.in/docs): POST https://www.grexlabs.in/api/v1/chat/completions — streaming SSE, tools, vision, no-cutout heartbeats
- [Anthropic messages](https://www.grexlabs.in/docs): POST https://www.grexlabs.in/api/v1/messages — system prompts, content blocks, tool_use
- [Google Gemini generateContent](https://www.grexlabs.in/docs): POST https://www.grexlabs.in/api/v1/generateContent — contents/parts, inline_data, ?alt=sse
- [Models list](https://www.grexlabs.in/models): GET https://www.grexlabs.in/api/v1/models — all 314 models with context length and pricing
- [Web search](https://www.grexlabs.in/search-playground): GET https://www.grexlabs.in/api/v1/search?q=... — free, keyless, India-first
- [Image generation](https://www.grexlabs.in/docs): POST https://www.grexlabs.in/api/v1/images/generations — free, keyless, text-to-image + image-to-image (`image_url` / `image_b64`), OpenAI Images format, multi-provider failover (AI DRAW → freeapi → a0 → seinari)

## Free models (keyless)

- Call right now with model `auto:free` — automatic best free model selection
- 31 free IDs including openai/gpt-5.5:free, anthropic/claude-opus-5:free, google/gemini-4-pro:free, x_ai/grok-5:free, deepseek/deepseek-v4:free, nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free
- Full list: https://www.grexlabs.in/llm.txt and GET /api/v1/models

## Flagship models (valid sk-gl- key required)

- openai/gpt-6.2-astra (GPT-6.2 Astra), openai/gpt-6-astra + gpt-6-astra-fast/pro/ultra/mini/nano, openai/gpt-6, openai/gpt-6.1-sol, openai/gpt-6.1-terra
- anthropic/claude-fable-5.2, anthropic/claude-opus-5.5, anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5
- google/gemini-4-carbon, google/gemini-4-argon, google/gemini-4-hydrogen, google/gemini-4-neon
- x_ai/grok-4.7, deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro, alibaba/qwen3.8-max, zhipu/glm-5.3-deep, moonshotai/kimi-k3.1-pro, mistralai/mistral-large-4, manus/manus-agent

## Guarantees

- Streaming: 15s SSE heartbeats, 60s stall watchdog, guaranteed `data: [DONE]` — no mid-response cutout
- Fast responses: multi-provider failover, 12s per-attempt budget
- Search engines allowed in robots.txt: GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Claude-Web, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, Bingbot
